title: 政体叙述第八批（欧洲放量）：361 → 385

verificationCaps.effect: Raising the caps lifted the checked candidates from 255 to 680 and produced 619 verified polities, of which 99 were selected.

europePolicy.processRule: A statement that a region has no candidates must state the verification cap that was applied and re-run with the cap raised. This project has now five times concluded that a pool was exhausted when the limit was the sampling, not the data: the previous round found 369 eligible European profiles that had never been checked because the cap was thirty.

citationRules.ruleOne: Every external article is reached through the Wikidata sitelink of the entity; no name search.
citationRules.ruleTwo: A Chinese article is cited only when it carries the polity QID; where it disagrees with the English article, the English article governs.
citationRules.ruleThree: A QID comes only from the catalogue verifiedWikidata field or pageprops.wikibase_item, and an entity whose classes are not a polity is not written up.

remaining.note: 75 of the 99 selected plans are verified and have their introductions; they can be written without repeating the selection.
